destinations.title: Dubai Marina
destinations.query: Dubai Marina metro station
destinations.lead: The Dubai Marina tram stop is on Dubai Marina Walk. The nearest metro station is Sobha Realty, which used to be called Dubai Marina (and later DAMAC Properties); it is about 6 minutes on foot from the tram stop.

destinations.title: JBR (Jumeirah Beach Residence)
destinations.query: JBR metro station
destinations.lead: There is no metro station at JBR. The Dubai Tram stops at Jumeirah Beach Residence 1 and 2, and the nearest metro stations are reached by tram and a short walk.

destinations.title: Dubai Airport (DXB)
destinations.query: Dubai Airport metro station, Terminal 1, 2 and 3
destinations.lead: Airport Terminal 1 and Airport Terminal 3 are stations on the Red Line, each linked to its terminal: about 5 minutes on foot, follow the Metro signs. Terminal 2 is not on the Metro: take the bus from Stadium or Abu Hail (Green Line), or a taxi.
